newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets reverses at 2.75 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets reverses at 2.75 percent.

text.p: The Bank of Canada set reverse repurchase agreements at 2.75 percent in the Canadian money market to pull up a sagging overnight rate, dealers said.

They said the central bank intervened to confirm its target range of 2.75 percent to 3.25 percent for the overnight rate after it fell to the floor of the range from this morning's opening levels around 3.00 percent.

After the intervention, Canada's three-month when-issued T-bill yield was up one basis point at 3.03 percent from this morning's opening levels, while the overnight rate persisted around 2.75 percent. ((Paul Casciato, Reuters Toronto Bureau 416 941-8100 or email: paul.casciato@reuters.com))
